text: The Local Appeal Body Nominating Panel must select candidates for interview to fill four vacancies on the Toronto Local Appeal Body. The Nominating Panel will conduct the interviews at its November 23, 2018 meeting and make recommendations to City Council.

The Local Appeal Body Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body: Candidate #30 Candidate #68 Candidate #76 Candidate #128 Candidate #150 Candidate #154 Candidate #164 Candidate #196 Candidate #197 Candidate #204 Candidate #208 Candidate #211 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 30, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.
